abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single configuration of Mail and Packages is allowed.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth unauthorized: access was denied or the authentication was cancelled.
abort.oauth_imap_refused: You signed in, but {host} refused mail (IMAP) access for {username}. Check that the address you entered is the account you signed in with, that IMAP is turned on for the mailbox (Gmail settings, or Exchange admin center > mailbox > Email apps for Microsoft 365), and that your app includes the mail permission. The OAuth2 setup section of the Mail and Packages wiki has the details.
abort.oauth_cannot_connect: You signed in, but Home Assistant could not reach {host}. Check the server name and port, and that Home Assistant can reach the internet, then try again.
abort.oauth_missing_inbox: You signed in, but the mailbox for {username} has no inbox Home Assistant can open.
abort.missing_credentials: No OAuth app is set up for Mail and Packages yet. Add your Google or Microsoft client ID and secret under Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials, then try again. The OAuth2 setup section of the Mail and Packages wiki has the details.
abort.missing_configuration: No OAuth app is set up for Mail and Packages yet. Add your client ID and secret under Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials.
abort.oauth_error: The sign-in service returned an error. Check that your OAuth app uses the My Home Assistant OAuth redirect URI and, for Microsoft, that the app allows accounts in any organizational directory. The OAuth2 setup section of the Mail and Packages wiki has details.
abort.oauth_failed: Sign-in did not finish. Please try again.
abort.oauth_timeout: Sign-in took too long to finish. Please try again.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out preparing the sign-in page. Please try again.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL configured for the sign-in redirect. Set one under Settings > System > Network.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: Sign-in was cancelled or access was not granted.

user.description:
Select how Mail and Packages signs in to your mailbox.

Password works with any IMAP mail server that accepts a password or app password.

The Google (Gmail) and Microsoft (Outlook/Exchange) options sign in with that account instead. Before picking one, register your own OAuth app with Google or Microsoft and add it under Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials. The OAuth2 setup section of the Mail and Packages wiki has step by step notes.
user.title: Authentication Method

imap_config.description:
Please enter the connection information of your mail server.

For Google or Microsoft sign in, the username has to be the exact address of the account you will sign in with; the sign in page selects it for you. Gmail uses imap.gmail.com and Microsoft 365 uses outlook.office365.com, both on port 993 with SSL.

A Microsoft app has to allow accounts in any organizational directory (multitenant) and include the My Home Assistant OAuth redirect URI. If sign in fails, see the OAuth2 setup section of the Mail and Packages wiki.
imap_config.title: Mail and Packages (Step 1 of 2)

confirm.description:
The 'Create image for notification apps' (`allow_external`) setting is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Images are now served securely via Home Assistant API endpoints using signed URLs without copying files to `/config/www/mail_and_packages/`.

Click Submit to automatically disable this deprecated option on your configuration.
